definitions.explanation: Items used in daily life, such as toiletries, cleaning supplies, and household basics.

examples.japanese: {日用品|にちようひん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Where is the daily necessities section?

examples.japanese: ⟦ドラッグストア→ドラッグストア：09710_doraggusutoa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{日用品|にちようひん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought daily necessities and food at the drugstore.

notes:
{日用品|にちようひん} combines {日用|にちよう} (daily use) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (goods). It covers toiletries, cleaning supplies, and household basics.

- ⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧: detergent
- ⟦{石鹸|せっけん}→石鹸：04981_sekken⟧: soap
- ⟦{歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ}→歯磨き粉：04983_hamigakiko⟧: toothpaste
- ⟦トイレットペーパー→トイレットペーパー：23785_toirettopeepaa⟧: toilet paper
- ⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧: tissues
